name: How long does it take to install a window stool?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a window stool?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install a window stool varies depending on the window size, the wall condition, the complexity of the trim profile, and whether it's a new installation or a replacement. A single, straightforward installation might take a few hours, while multiple windows or custom designs could extend the timeline. When you work with Maine Results, Inc., our team provides a clearer estimate after assessing the specific conditions at your Garden City or Kuna home, factoring in any necessary preparatory work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies based on window size, wall condition, and trim complexity, typically a few hours for a single stool or longer for multiple/custom designs.
